inputs.text:
Folks, we are once again being asked to fall for the oldest trick in the ruling-class playbook. The Department of Homeland Security is desperately trying to sanitize an inherently oppressive policing institution that terrorizes vulnerable communities, shoving a video in our faces from Thursday at JFK International Airport in New York. They want us to applaud an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent just because some footage showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin. 

It is staggering to watch the conservative establishment and their elite mouthpieces lecture us about duty, trying to use a human tragedy to prop up their failing militarized borders. They want us to completely ignore the systemic violence of these federal agencies, which tear families apart at the border every single day, and instead paint them as benevolent protectors of the social order. This is nothing more than a transparent PR stunt for a system built on exclusion and fear. We know where real safety lies—true community care and safety won't be found in armed agents patrolling checkpoints, but in dismantling these harmful structures altogether.
